remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at Amer. Place, April 1946....On backing Intimate Gal. label with following in ink by O'Keeffe, 'Lake George, 1925/by Georgia O'Keeffe.' Initials" [not verified].Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "The date given on the label is wrong. O'Keeffe has identified this as 'Storm Cloud, Lake George,' which was No. 15 in O'Keeffe exh. at Anderson Gals, March 1924. Ptd. 1923. Dark – one of the best early Lake George pictures." Pictured in 1924 New York ) (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see appendix III, figure 24. See cat. no. 1948. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.notes: Source of title: Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks, 1924 New York (Anderson) checklist.
titles.title: Storm Cloud, Lake George

description: Horizontal landscape of very dark silhouette of mountains, with wavy grey curves on black in the foreground.  Above the hills the sky is orange with grey swirling looming clouds above spanning the top edge of the canvas.
title: Storm Cloud, Lake George
